issue.description: Found 2026-10-07 confirming redaction across real stores. resolve_redaction_finding does a full live scan (org scanner per field) plus, on a miss, a full scan of both retained generations, per fingerprint; select_all_blocking_holding calls it per blocking finding, redact_findings_holding calls it again per fingerprint inside the IMMEDIATE transaction, and apply_redaction rescans live state once more per member. Lab ~/pdftract (4161 issues, 19747 events, 63M checkpoint, 51 blocking findings; inventory alone 38s) did not finish a --all-blocking --dry-run in 15 minutes while holding the write lock. Fix: batch resolvers find_live_findings / find_retained_checkpoint_findings (one pass for the fingerprint set, same ambiguity semantics; single-fingerprint functions become wrappers), used by selection and the batch transaction; apply_redaction skips its rescan when the location was resolved in the same transaction (single-field revalidation kept); canonicalize_event_target skips the rescan when canonicalization changed nothing. Acceptance: lab pdftract dry run and real run complete in roughly inventory time; redaction suites and full suite green; e2e both modes both hosts.
issue.notes: Shipped 7e3212ab (pushed to main). Verification: TMPDIR=/var/tmp cargo test --no-fail-fast 1710 passed 0 failed; clippy --all-targets -D warnings clean; redaction suites (redact_all_blocking 5, redaction_* 26, secret_gap_contract 31, secret_rejection 10, lib 348) green. Lab pdftract copy: --all-blocking dry run 91.7s (was >900s timeout), real run 140s, doctor 0 blocking after; copy removed. Release built via scripts/build-from-archive.sh 7e3212ab (sha256 836d73d25fcc...), installed codinghome ~/.cargo/bin/bead and lab ~/.local/bin/bead; redact-e2e.sh monolithic+sharded on both hosts: 0 blocking, 0 files holding values. No real store was redacted in this bead.

issue.description:
Field evidence gathered 2026-10-23 on codinghome: a sweep of all 92 bead-rs workspaces under /home/coding, git object accounting in the largest repos, and every bead invocation in agent transcripts under ~/.claude/projects (32,149 calls) and ~/.codex/sessions (80,311 calls). Counts are regex-based and approximate.

Problem: agents hit git trouble on checkpoint files 288 times across 209 sessions: `cannot pull with rebase` 107, `local changes would be overwritten` 71, unmerged/needs merge 61, `CONFLICT` 49. The files named were current.json (139), forensic.jsonl (122) and previous.json (90). Ideas ledger run 4, item 14, killed a three-way merge driver on the premise that a conflicted pull resolves by taking either checkpoint side and then reconciling and reflushing. The field evidence shows agents do not complete that manual recipe; this environment's own rule forbids hand-resolving `.beads`. No spec covers a checkpoint whose files are git-conflicted.

Scope:
- `bead sync resolve` detects unmerged index entries under .beads/checkpoint. It restores the incoming side's verified pointer and objects, then merges live state with them through the existing reconcile and divergent-branch machinery, so neither side's history is lost. It republishes and stages exactly the checkpoint fileset, so `git rebase --continue` or `git commit` can proceed.
- Conflicts outside .beads/checkpoint are never touched.
- Any bead command that finds conflict markers or unmerged checkpoint paths fails closed with an error naming `bead sync resolve`, and `sync status` names it too.
- It operates on the published-fileset abstraction, not on fixed filenames, so it keeps working after the incremental layout (field-evidence-2026-10-23:incremental-impl) lands.
- Spec: add a conflicted-checkpoint section to research/specs/remote-advanced-reconcile-v1.md.
- A git merge driver stays out of scope.

Acceptance:
- Two clones mutate different issues; the pull conflicts; `sync resolve` leaves both mutations present, a verifying checkpoint, and a rebase that continues cleanly.
- The same issue mutated on both sides follows the existing divergent-branch rules, and nothing is silently dropped.
- A conflicted non-checkpoint file is left exactly as git left it.
- With nothing conflicted, the command exits 0 and changes nothing.
- cargo fmt --check, cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings, and cargo test pass.

Preserved verbatim at ~/.needle/state/gates/56d6e5b4-wip-sync-resolve-20261025/ (sync_resolve.rs, sync_resolve_conflicts.rs, main.rs-wip-hunk.diff) before a7e7afac committed its own fixes; the checkout copies of main.rs and the untracked test are untouched.
